narr: Scattered thunderstorms in advance of a surface trough produced heavy rain which caused flash flooding across portions of southeast Virginia.
ev: High water was reported on Kimberley Bridge, and along East Constance Road and West Constance Road (2nd Avenue).
lsr: HIGH WATER REPORTED ON KIMBERLEY BRIDGE, AND ALONG EAST CONSTANCE ROAD AND WEST CONSTANCE ROAD (2ND AVENUE).
